title: Giant infinite tree of golden light dream
content: Basically in the dream I open my eyes and notice I’m sitting on a tree branch or…the tree branch IS me. It’s hard to describe. Basically the tree is life itself and it’s all one thing. Each person or thing is a separate branch unto itself. When I look up at the other branches the trunk seems to stretch upward into infinity. I cannot see the top, only branches coming off the trunk out into the infinite expanse. In this dream I can feel my fear of death is entirely gone because I can literally see that I am this massive infinite thing which never actually dies. The loss of the fear of death persisted for about 3 days or so after the dream. It was extremely vivid.
